docs.docsDescription: Start using yokoten in three steps: check Node, run npx yokoten in your project, and do what its Next line says.
docs.stoppedDescription: What a yokoten stop means, how to read its Why, Instead and More lines, what to tell your agent, and what to do if a stop looks wrong.
docs.overviewDescription: What yokoten is, what it stops and how it works: the README of the yokoten repository.
docs.docsRoadDescription: Every stage of the yokoten road and every step in it, with why it matters, as the CLI words them.

notice.text: Node.js security releases (October 2026): update Node to 22.23.4, 24.22.1 or 26.12.1 before you use yokoten

footer.note: Yokoten (横展) comes from Toyota's factories: the lessons learned on one line spread to every line. yokoten does that for your projects: a lesson one project learns is offered to the rest.
